services.name: Cultural Guide
services.text: Markets, history, food and daily life explained by someone who grew up there. Half or full day, at your pace.

services.name: Wildlife & Nature Guide
services.text: Spot lemurs, birds and chameleons with a naturalist who knows exactly where and when to look.

services.name: Adventure & Trek Guide
services.text: Hikes, canyons and coastal trails led by trained, first-aid certified guides, adapted to your level.

services.name: Trip Companion
services.text: A Noziwild host who welcomes you, handles logistics and stays reachable from arrival to departure.

guides.bio: Hery leads small-group wildlife walks and knows exactly when and where to find the island’s most unusual animals.
Lina shares the history, food and traditions of the island and connects travelers with the people who keep them alive.
Tojo designs treks that match your level, with the right pace, the right stops and safety always first.
Mika takes care of every detail so you can simply enjoy the trip, and is one call away whenever you need.

rows.label: Same guide for the whole trip

day.title: Pickup At Your Hotel
day.text: Meet your guide, get a quick overview of the day and adjust the plan to your mood and the weather.

day.title: First Discovery
day.text: A market, a trail or a village, depending on your guide. This is where the stories start.

day.title: Lunch With Locals
day.text: A family table or a small restaurant your guide loves, far from the tourist menus.

day.title: Slow Afternoon
day.text: Swim, walk or simply relax. The pace is yours and your guide adapts.

day.title: Back For Sunset
day.text: A tip for tonight’s dinner, a photo at the best spot and a plan for tomorrow.

testimonials.text: Our guide made the whole trip. He knew every path, every family and every story. We would not have found half of it alone.
Lina showed us a side of the island we never expected. The food, the people, the little workshops. Truly unforgettable.
The trek was challenging but perfectly paced. We always felt safe, and the views were worth every step.
Having one person to call for everything made our family trip stress-free. The kids still talk about their guide.
We saw lemurs on the first morning thanks to Hery. He knew exactly where to go and when. Amazing.

faqs.q: Do I need a guide for my whole trip?
faqs.a: No. Many travelers book a guide only for key days, like a national park or a trek, and explore freely the rest of the time.
Yes. Tell us your interests and language and we suggest the best match. You can also request a guide you already know.

faqs.q: What languages do your guides speak?
faqs.a: English and French are covered on all trips. Italian, German and Spanish are available on request.

faqs.q: What if I have a problem during the trip?
faqs.a: Every trip includes our support line. If needed, a team member reaches you or arranges help on the spot.
No, tips are always optional. If you enjoyed the day, a small tip to your guide is much appreciated.

title: Local Experts, Real Stories
intro: A good guide turns a nice trip into a story you tell for years. Choose a local expert for a day, or have a Noziwild companion at your side all the way.
